note: market/: standing bids priced per verified sat and perpetual callable loans, against Pusakas through NEP-171/178/199. No upgrade path in the code; the account's key is deleted at the final deploy (13 Nov), after which the code can never change.

code.build: cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --no-abi (cargo-near 0.22.0), in market/
